# CORE-SEC-01

**Are trust zones declared and every element placed in one?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | SEC: Security architecture |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `trust_zones`, `elements.trust_zone` |

## Rule

trust_zones is non-empty and every element other than an actor has trust_zone.

## Sources

- Threat Modeling Manifesto (`tmm`)
- NIST SP 800-160 Vol. 1 Rev. 1, Engineering Trustworthy Secure Systems (2022) (`nist-800-160`)
